title: Venezuelan Puffed Pastry Plantains
description: A delicious and crispy dessert made with puffed pastry, sweet plantains, and a touch of Venezuelan flair.
instructions: Peel the plantains and slice them into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
Place the plantain slices in a single layer on the puffed pastry.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the plantains to create a crust.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown and the plantains are tender.
